statement.p: Let (x_0, y_0) = (2, 3) and (x_1, y_1) = (2.4, 3.5). Use the following graph of the function f to find the indicated derivatives.

image.shortdescription: Graph of a function and its tangent line at a point.

description.p: graph of a function passing through the point (x_0,y_0) and the line tangent to the function at (x_0,y_0) which also passes through the point (x_1,y_1)

solution.p: Since the point (2,3) is on the curve, we know f(2)=3. The point (2.4,3.5) is on the tangent line, so \hbox{Slope of tangent} = \frac{3.5-3}{2.4-2} = \frac{0.5}{0.4} = 1.25. Thus, f'(2)=1.25.
By the chain rule h'(2) = 2(f(2))\cdot f'(2) =2\cdot 3\cdot 1.25 = 7.5.

Because g(x) is the inverse function of f, we know that g(3) = 2. Then note that f(g(x)) = f(f^{-1}(x)) = x, so f(g(x)) = x. Differentiating both sides of the equation, f'(g(x))\cdot g'(x) = 1, so g'(x) = \frac{1}{f'(g(x))}. Thus g'(3) = \frac{1}{f'(g(3))} = \frac{1}{f'(2)} = \frac1{1.25}.
